# Bibliography

Every external source that the documentation cites, described once. A page cites an entry by its key in a footnote; the key is the anchor of the entry on this page ([references standard](../standards/references.md), [ADR 0021](../adr/0021-citation-and-reference-model.md)).

Tier 1 is a primary source, tier 2 vendor technical documentation, tier 3 news used for dates of events only. A *pinned* source does not change; a *living* page can change and shows the date it was last checked against the text.
